question: Trong cùng mô hình LLM và cấu hình suy luận, cross-service context có cải thiện độ chính xác phân tích nguyên nhân và chất lượng bằng chứng so với single-service context hay không?
primary: Paired Cross minus Single root cause accuracy among fault pairs scorable in both modes
normal: Separate negative control; false attribution on analyzed Normal, plus abstention and coverage; excluded from primary
abstention: Null for conditional primary; report by mode and count as unsuccessful in fault end-to-end sensitivity
alternatives: Reviewer adjudicates acceptable cause/service variants before provider calls
projection: Same final persisted Cross snapshot, exact Order event projection with identical ordering and contents, same sanitizer and budget; log selected IDs and trim omissions
selection: Freeze one settled snapshot per trace after fixed reconciliation cutoff; no post-output selection

analysis.uncertainty: descriptive only for feasibility; report by group, family and Cross completeness

model.decoding: SDK defaults for unspecified options; no tools; temperature not sent

required_before_lock: canonical hashes for prompt + rubric + schema + build + snapshots
